items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period — you may begin contributing from your first payroll run.

Life and disability insurance coverage begins when the medical waiting period ends.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one, before coverage begins
- Check MosaicOne Benefits for your digital cards when eligibility arrives

Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: If you have any doubt about whether a message is legitimate, contact IT Security at it-security@mosaicrobotics.example or use the duty line on the back of your employee badge.

Next steps:
- Report to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not send any data

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories, including items such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, and small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance; they are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claims by 20th of month for same-month reimbursement

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, adopted, became a parent through surrogacy, or foster placement leading to adoption.

Parental leave eligibility begins after 6 months of continuous service. An employee who becomes a parent before reaching six months receives the statutory entitlement their jurisdiction provides, and the company benefit begins the day the service requirement is met.

An employee who gives birth also receives any period of medical disability leave certified by their clinician before the parental leave begins. The disability period is paid through short-term disability rather than as parental leave, and it does not reduce the 16 weeks.

Next steps:
- Confirm your eligibility and service date with People Operations
- Discuss timing and scheduling options with your manager

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering the room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates. MosaicOne Travel applies the higher cap automatically for those markets.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — you book the most reasonable available option and note the reason. No pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Book through MosaicOne Travel
- Note reason if cap cannot be met

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days also requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

The employee must hold the right to work in the destination country, must meet the device and connectivity requirements, and must stay inside the company's rolling 90-day annual limit.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review 21 days before departure
- Obtain director approval in MosaicOne
- Notify IT Security 5 business days ahead

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports USD 2,501 to USD 10,000 require director approval and a Finance business partner review.

Every trip needs manager approval before booking.

Days since the transaction: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

The full required training set for every employee includes security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Security and acceptable-use training is completed within 14 calendar days of the start date and refreshed annually.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and a new hire may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run with no waiting period.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date, and have 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

IT ships standard equipment—laptop, adapter, headset, and for remote hires the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock—to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Finish all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections before day 120

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

A laptop refresh above USD 500 requires direct manager approval and director approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment.

Next steps:
- Contact IT to schedule the swap
- Coordinate with your director for approval

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Response means a named human being contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Next steps:
- Contact Employee Relations for harassment, discrimination or retaliation reports.
- Refer to the Workplace Conduct Policy for investigation process details.

You have 13.5 PTO days remaining.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

A manager may waive the notice requirement for a request that falls inside the window. Unforeseeable absences — a sudden illness, a family emergency, a transport failure that makes work impossible — are never held to the notice requirement; you notify your manager as early as you reasonably can, and the absence is entered in MosaicOne retroactively.

PTO requests of any length are approved by your direct manager. Requests of 6 to 15 consecutive business days require 15 business days notice, and requests of more than 15 consecutive business days require director approval in addition to your manager's approval.

Your request goes to Dana, your direct manager.

Next steps:
- Submit PTO requests in MosaicOne with appropriate notice.
- Contact Dana (your manager Dana) if you need a notice waiver.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance.

Every PTO request requires written approval from your direct manager in MosaicOne.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the direct manager.

Your PTO balance is 13.5 days, which covers the 3 days you are requesting.

A manager may waive the notice requirement; the waiver is recorded so People Operations can review it quarterly.

A stay of 30 consecutive days or fewer in an approved country requires manager approval under the Remote & Hybrid Work Policy and nothing further from Tax & Legal.

Your trip is 20 consecutive calendar days, and Ireland is an approved destination.

Ireland is one of seven approved destinations for temporary work abroad: Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, Canada and Mexico.

International remote work of up to 30 consecutive days in an approved country requires approval from your direct manager only, with 21 calendar days' notice.

Recommendation — not company policy: You do not need Tax & Legal review for this trip. However, you must obtain written manager approval from Dana at least 21 calendar days before departure—that is, by 10 September at the latest. Raise the request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with the exact dates and workspace address, and discuss with Dana whether an expedited approval is possible.

Since you submitted this request on 22 September, you are currently 9 calendar days short of the required notice.

You must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN, and IT Security must be notified of Ireland at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules can be adjusted.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad.

Your benefits waiting period ends on 13 November 2026.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

You have 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits. If you make no election within that window, you are enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default, and may not change it until the next open enrollment or a qualifying life event.

Next steps:
- Review plan options in MosaicOne Benefits before 13 December 2026.
- Contact benefits@mosaicrobotics.example with eligibility questions.
